1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Improved Sprint makes activating Sprint remove all movement impairing effects and grant immunity to all movement impairing effects for 2 seconds.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Emberstorm now makes Searing Pain casts reduce the cooldown of Chaos Bolt by 3 seconds.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Empowered Touch now makes your Healing Touch casts reduce the cooldown of your Natural Alacrity by 3 seconds.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Remorseless Attacks refreshes your Slice and Dice duration to its 5 combo point maximum when you kill an enemy that yields experience or honor.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Improved Poisons now increases your chance to hit with poisons by 10%.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Malice makes you gain 4 energy when your Garrote or Rupture deal damage.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Sinister calling now makes your Hemorrhage apply an extra combo point when cast on a target that is bleeding.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Steady Shot now deals 110% weapon damage.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Reduced the proc rate of Furious Attacks by 20%.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: áµThe damage of Bloodthirst is increased by 10% per Rend, Garrote or Rupture that you have applied on the target.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Weapon Mastery now properly procs off all melee attacks, not only auto-attacks.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: The first rank of Improved Sprint no longer has a chance to grant immunity nor to remove movement impairing effects.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Empowered Imp now increases the critical strike chance of your next Destruction Warlock spell by 100%, from 50%.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Empowered Imp now has a 33/66/100% chance to proc, from 100/100/100%.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Update borrowed time tooltip to say it gives haste and is consumed by next cast with a cast time.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Empowered Stormstrike's Shock attack power scaling has been increased by to 1.25%, from 4%. Its spell power scaling has been reduced from 5% to 4%.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Tidal Focus now reduces the mana cost of Shaman healing spells by 3/6/9/12/15%, from 2/4/6/8/10%.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Eclipse has a 100% chance to proc from Wrath hits, from 60%.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: When Shattering Throw does not remove an immunity, it instead applies 5 stacks of Sunder Armor reduces its cooldown by 30 seconds.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Sanctity of Battle no longer increases critical strike chance.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Darkness now also increases the damage of Mind Blast by 10% while active.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Ghostly Strike now increases chance to Parry if a Two-Handed weapon is equipped, else it increases chance to Dodge. Setup no longer converts this Dodge into Parry.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Shield Mastery now grants 5/10% increased block value, from 10/20%.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Benediction (Retribution talent) now restores 4/8/12/16/20% of your base mana when you kill a target that gives experience or honor. This effect cannot occur more than once every 10 seconds.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: The attack power scaling of Bloodthirst has been increased to 45%, from 43%.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: The mana regeneration effect of Holy Concentration no longer only procs off critical heals, and the duration increase of Renew is now also triggered by Circle of Healing.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: Honor Among Thieves now has a 3 second internal cooldown, up from 2. It no longer procs of auto-attacks.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: The duration of the Serrated Blades proc effect has been increased to 12 seconds, from 8.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: The spell haste granted by Borrowed Time has been reduced to 4/8/12/16/20%, from 5/10/15/20/25%. The tooltip has also been updated to indicate that this effect is not consumed by instant cast spells.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: The base damage and scaling of Drain Life has been increased by 5%.

1.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
1.description: The base damage and scaling of Mind Flay has been increased by 5%.

7.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
7.description: Alembic has been reworked to grant 20% base mana, from 260 mana. It now has a 5% chance to proc, from 2%, and a 10 second internal cooldown.

7.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
7.description: Renewed Energy should now restore 20% of base mana as intended.

7.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
7.description: Demonic Synergy now increases your pets critical strike chance by 40/50%, from 50/100%.

7.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
7.description: Divine Providence now also increases the healing of Greater Heal.

7.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
7.description: Unending Fury now also increases the damage of Whirlwind.

7.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
7.description: Crackling Thunder has had its Attack Power scaling reduced to 5% per tick, from 7%.

7.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
7.description: Holy Radiance has been reworked. It now makes your Greater Heal also heal all friendly targets affected by your Renew for 15% of the amount.

7.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
7.description: Quick Death now grants 4% haste per stack, from 5. It now lasts for 15 seconds, from 12.

7.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
7.description: New Legendary RE - Eternal Water: Your Summon Water Elemental now lasts indefinitely, but your Water Elemental can no longer cast Freeze.

7.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
7.description: New Legendary RE - Paratrooper: Your Disengage now launches you higher into the air and activates a Combat Parachute until you land. While airborne, the high vantage point increases the critical strike chance of your Hunter shots by 25%. When the parachute is detached you gain 80% ranged attack speed for 4 seconds.
